
Category: Cybersecurity
Importance: 8
Attackers compromised three country code top-level domains to obtain unauthorized TLS certificates for Google and other major organizations. This security breach allows them to impersonate legitimate websites, posing a risk to users' data and safety. Google has blocked known unauthorized certificates and advised domain owners to monitor their certificate issuance processes to prevent future incidents.

 - Hackers hijacked domain registries to mint counterfeit TLS certificates.
 - Unauthorized certificates allow attackers to impersonate legitimate services.
 - Google has implemented measures to block known unauthorized certificates and is advising precautionary steps for domain owners.

Source: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/hackers-obtain-counterfeit-tls-certificates-for-google-and-other-large-services/

A new proof-of-concept cyber technique named 'BigDiskBuster' has been developed that prevents Microsoft Defender from receiving updates without exploiting vulnerabilities. By creating a hidden file that claims all available free disk space, this technique effectively creates a detection gap, allowing malware to persist undetected on systems running Defender.

 - BigDiskBuster prevents Defender from updating, while the service continues to run normally.
 - The attack could potentially extend the lifespan of existing malware on a victim's machine.

Experiments indicate that both Muon and Conv-NS are computationally efficient and yield similar accuracy in image classification tasks.

These findings suggest that verification mechanisms are critical for ensuring mathematical problem-solving reliability.

 - Optional verification relies on agents' active choice, impacting their robustness.
